welcome.title: Hello and welcome to my online CV!
paragraphs: I am a Security Analyst at scip AG.
My focus is offensive security, and research how AI systems can support red team work.
This website is a small project of mine that I've occasionally been working on to help showcase my skills and recent projects. Enjoy!

profile.text: I'm a Security Analyst at scip AG, based in Switzerland, with a BSc in Information & Cyber Security from HSLU, where I majored in the security of cloud, mobile and IoT systems. I enjoy both the offensive side of the job and the engineering behind it, from writing internal tooling to experimenting with AI in red team workflows.

currentWork.title: What I'm Currently Working On
paragraphs: At scip AG my days are a mix of network scanning, web application and mobile penetration tests, report writing and peer reviews, plus internal software projects that make our testing workflow faster.

On the research side I'm experimenting with AI systems for red team workflows: where they help, where they get in the way, and how to keep them from doing anything dumb on a live engagement. Reports and results from my student projects can be downloaded from the "Projects" section of this website.
